description:
Stated plainly by the fz-kdt.93 builder (2026-08-31, 2f3605e28) and
deliberately not closed there: the structural cut covers (a) static edges
via CallGraphComponent + non-rising function id and (b) grounded
ClosureCallReturn edges whose target STATICALLY REACHES the owner
(statically_reaches, transport.rs:1754-1776). A product cycle in which
EVERY grounded edge fails that reachability test would be uncut ->
permanent transport non-settlement, and the deleted knot protocol is no
longer a second net.

STATUS after two independent construction campaigns (builder round 2 +
the verification refuter's three engineered cycles pingpong.fz /
pingpong_cap.fz / pingpong_capchain.fz, instrumented to confirm ALL
grounded edges kept, reaches=false): NO WEDGE CONSTRUCTIBLE. The refuter
identified WHY, and the argument belongs here: on every such cycle the
callee value's carrier is ValueRef at evaluation, so ClosureCallReturn
takes PublicCallableReturn and never creates the product edge -- the
loop-carrying callable must cross a closure-call argument or a boxed join
somewhere (captures only reach OLDER values, so a cycle cannot close
through captures alone), and that flow gets the boxed rep upstream in
demand facts. All three constructions' canon dumps are byte-identical
under pending.reverse(): the severing is fact-derived, not schedule luck.
This is an OBSERVED invariant of the boxing seam, not a proof -- the hole
stays open as a record until someone either proves it (temporal argument
over demand facts) or constructs the wedge (then this is a P1 wedge bug).

CLOSING MECHANISM (named, not built): an augmented-reachability FACT
(static graph + resolved singleton closure-call targets) with proper
derivation/subscription discipline -- a new FactKey/job.

HOUSEKEEPING RIDER (refuter NIT, same code): statically_reaches is
unmemoized and subscribes wide -- each grounded-edge evaluation re-walks
the reachable static cone and read_facts StaticCallees for every visited
function, so the transport product re-wakes on any callee-set change in
the cone. Correct and rare-path today; if grounded edges multiply, the
memo/fact promotion above solves both problems at once.
title: Residual transport-cut hole: a cycle whose every grounded closure-call edge's target cannot statically reach its owner is uncut
